known_conflicts.decision: The source configuration uses the tighter journal-specific limit; recheck the current journal page and submission form.

known_conflicts.topic: Non-PRL Letter data-availability and appendix headings
known_conflicts.decision: The 2026 general guide and observed current Letter production differ. Preserve the distinction between explicit general guidance and journal/article-type observations; do not claim an explicit exception or infer an unobserved journal format.

official_rule_summaries.summary: The inherited author-page check found no general word limit for Regular Articles and 4500 APS-equivalent words for Letters. Apply a Letter budget only when that article type is selected.
The inherited author-page check records a separate 100-word suitability justification for original research and Letters, and titles in published references.
An appendix in the main manuscript is generally preferred; the paper must support its conclusions without using Supplemental Material to evade length limits.

Explain the connection between physical insight and application research, substantive progress, and relevant readers. This does not require commercialization or a complete final system in every paper.
Distinguish light editing from substantive AI research or writing use and disclose actual use when required. Natural prose does not replace disclosure.
